title: Adversarial Attacks on Downstream Weather Forecasting Models: Application to Tropical Cyclone Trajectory Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2510.10140v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep learning-based weather forecasting (DLWF) models leverage past weather observations to generate future forecasts, supporting a wide range of downstream applications, including tropical cyclone (TC) prediction. In this paper, we investigate the vulnerability of these models to adversarial attacks, where subtle perturbations to upstream forecasts can alter downstream TC trajectory predictions. Crafting perturbed inputs to steer downstream outputs toward attacker-specified trajectories is a challenging problem for several reasons. First, conventional TC detection systems are opaque, non-differentiable black boxes, making standard gradient-based attacks infeasible. Second, the extreme rarity of TC events leads to a severe class imbalance problem, making it difficult to develop attack methods that produce realistic-looking cyclone paths aligned with target trajectories. translated_title: 针对下游天气预报模型的对抗攻击：在热带气旋轨迹预测中的应用
translated_abstract: 基于深度学习的天气预报（DLWF）模型利用过去的天气观测数据生成未来的预报，支持广泛的下游应用，其中包括热带气旋（TC）预测。本文研究了这些模型对对抗攻击的脆弱性，即对上游预报施加细微扰动即可改变下游的热带气旋轨迹预测。构建扰动输入以将下游输出引导至攻击者指定的轨迹是一个极具挑战性的问题，原因如下：首先，传统的热带气旋检测系统是不透明、不可微分的黑盒，使得标准的基于梯度的攻击方法无法实施；其次，热带气旋事件的极端稀有性导致了严重的类别不平衡问题，使得难以开发出能够生成与目标轨迹相符的逼真气旋路径的攻击方法。为克服这些限制，我们提出了Cyc-Attack这一新颖的方法。
tldr: 本文提出了Cyc-Attack对抗攻击方法，通过对上游天气预报模型施加细微扰动来操纵下游热带气旋轨迹预测，克服了检测系统黑盒不可微分和热带气旋样本极度稀缺导致的类别不平衡两大难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Cyc-Attack, a novel adversarial attack that perturbs upstream weather forecasts to manipulate downstream tropical cyclone trajectory predictions, overcoming the challenges of non-differentiable black-box detection systems and extreme class imbalance from the rarity of tropical cyclone events.
